text:
Meet Gemini 4 Hydrogen: built for rapid coding, multimodal synthesis, and everyday workflows.

It finishes tasks 2.5x faster than 3.8 Flash and surpasses Argon on the @ArtificialAnlys Intelligence Index.

We built PlanAssist to help UK Government planning officers speed up building and renovations across the country.

Built with Gemini, it has shown it can cut the time planning officers spend assessing householder applications by up to 58%. It is now being made available to 12 more councils to help them to make faster decisions. 🏡 →

Using a single Nano Banana image and Blender MCP, Gemini 4 Argon built a 3D Gothic cathedral in @Antigravity.

It iterates on the geometry, textures, and lighting to create the finished scene.

Gemini 4 Argon combined three open-source datasets to build an interactive 3D visualization of human anatomy.

Toggle different layers in motion, isolate muscles, or zoom inside a beating heart.

Gemini 4 Argon built a 3D periodic table synced to Tom Lehrer’s song, “The Elements.”

Created in @Antigravity, it animates orbiting electrons, atomic data, and light spectra.

Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft from scratch in 27 hours.

Operating in a sandbox using only code and text, they wrote 2,783 programs, divided up jobs over chat, shared notes, and debugged errors together - all with no human help ↓

Together with scientists around the world, our models and tools are helping make disease more detectable, treatable, and preventable. 🧬

From pinpointing rare genetic variants to speeding up drug discovery, here’s how we’re helping turn lab breakthroughs into real-world care →

SynthID has been named one of @TIME's Best Inventions of 2026.

With over 180 billion images and videos already watermarked, it’s making it easier for people to distinguish AI-generated content from other media →

Over half of reported crimes in Singapore use sophisticated social engineering.

With @GovTechSG, we’re building on-device fraud detection using our open model Gemma.

By fine-tuning it on local scam tactics, it identifies threats in real time without compromising personal privacy →
